definitions.explanation: A sliding compartment in a piece of furniture for storing things.

examples.japanese: {引き出|ひきだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引き出|ひきだ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I put the documents in the drawer.

notes:
{引き出|ひきだ}し refers to a sliding storage compartment in furniture.

ETYMOLOGY:
From the verb ⟦{引き出|ひきだ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧ (to pull out), describing the pulling action to open it.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {引き出|ひきだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a drawer
- {引き出|ひきだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close a drawer
- {引き出|ひきだ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しまう→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧: to put away in a drawer
- {引き出|ひきだ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside the drawer

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引き出|ひきだ}し: desk drawer
- ⟦タンス→箪笥：05012_tansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引き出|ひきだ}し: dresser drawer
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: shelf
